name: a-flor-default
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Reedleaves mascot flower concept exploration, single complete character.
Input images: Image 1 is the PRIMARY SHAPE REFERENCE: existing active Plántula with two simple rounded pointed leaves; Image 2 is the PRIMARY FINISH AND PERSONALITY REFERENCE: reserved sprout character on earth, take its plump clean friendly silhouette, generous curved cream-white highlights, simple colored edge-shadow and minimal dark-green oval eyes plus curved closed smile; Image 3 is a SECONDARY reference only: Tallo, take a little of its sturdy rounded green stem and side leaves.
Primary request: Create exactly one complete friendly FLOWER mascot of the requested kind below, in the same visual family as those references. This is an exploration, not a realistic botanical illustration.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background. No floor shadow. No earth mound or pot.
Subject: a compact full-body flower character with a large readable flower head on a short chunky light-green rounded stem, two expressive fleshy green side leaves asymmetrically raised like arms. The FACE belongs on the flower head, with two well-separated tiny dark-green vertical oval eyes and a restrained curved closed smile. Keep face scale modest and familiar; no nose, cheeks, lashes, eyebrows, teeth, tongue or human hands.
Style/medium: very clean vector-like raster illustration, bold simple plush shapes without outline strokes, flat main color planes with ONE broad darker colored lower/right edge plane, only very slight smoothing, generous cream-white simple curved highlights. Not photorealistic, not 3D toy rendering. Recognizable at 48px.
Composition/framing: square canvas, one centered complete character, near-front view, full flower and full stem visible, no cropped parts, character occupies about 78% of canvas height. Comparable size and body plan across all six concepts.
Color palette: leaves vivid fresh lime #B9E877 / #83BD4D / #58BE59 and forest green #369247, face #173D2C; floral colors specified below.
Text: none.
Avoid: scene, lettering, labels, grids, multiple characters, border, texture, grain, gradients that look airbrushed, tiny botanical details, thin realistic stem, roots or feet, dressing or props.
Flower variant: The MOST DEFAULT FLOWER POSSIBLE, a very basic almost kindergarten pictogram flower: exactly FIVE oversized ROUND bubble-like soft PINK petals evenly arranged around ONE round golden-yellow center disk. No special species details. Simple childlike archetype, broad petals, large enough center for tiny face. Clearly default and iconic, warm light pink petals with rose-colored lower/right edge, golden center.
